items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722074/a9a026cb8a4c8b9ac8473785dc4e70a121975295.png"]We have loads more great stuff for our amazing ranchers, so get ready! We’ve started by expanding The Sanctuary, adding the Hideaway, with more rooms and themes, and we've adjusted the overlap for placing gadgets, so you have even more control over how you customize. And what’s all that without adding a load more decorations to choose from? How about a portable fabricator gadget as well!
Not custom enough? Then let’s customize your vac style too; select from new color loadouts and some unique vac variants as well - we know you always wanted lava in your vac.
Who’s that calling? After saving Rainbow Isle, it sounds like your friends have something to say; we’ve added some additional comm station calls for ranchers who have reached the end credits.
To top it off, check out the new music player in your Slimepedia and enjoy all that amazing, wiggly music at your fingertips!
Unlock an additional part of the Sanctuary with new rooms
Additional calls have been added to help tie a bow on Bea’s adventures in Rainbow Isle
Accessible through the Slimepedia, as you progress through the game more tracks will become available
These will become available for purchase as you progress in the game.
We’ve done a pass to a vast number of decorations to allow them to be placed closer together; giving more freedom and customization.

Portable Fabricator - the truly industrious rancher knows precious time is lost having to run back to the Conservatory to build more gadgets; well no more! For your major projects on Rainbow Isle, bring a Portable Fabricator™ with you.
Fixed a bug where teleporting to a new area while still loading into the current area could lock the screen
Corrected some locations in the Terrarium which could cause slimes to float, gadgets to not display, and drones to not be able to collect certain resources
Picking up a Distributor while it contains a radiant slime will no longer strip being radiant from it
Removed an exploit with Link Cannon’s being able sell plorts without losing them
Corrected an issue with the filter in Polestar Provision displaying Blueprints and Variants when it shouldn’t have
Sloomber Slime clouds are not visible within the Dream Lantern effect
This update has a good number of requests from our wonderful community; we want to thank you all for your feedback and we hope this brings a great big smile to your beautiful faces!

items.text: We are no longer collecting player data in-game and have made sure any potentially identifying information has been scrubbed, along with any data which could be linked to identifying information.
As such, we have adjusted the options menu to remove indicating that we collect player data.
If you have any questions or concerns, please see our Privacy Policy to learn more.

The Radiant Slime Sanctuary update features new variants of slimes altered by the Prisma Core; Radiant Slimes, with a different color palette and radiant effect. These slime will be very rare and can appear anywhere their normal version might pop out.

In addition, we are introducing the Caretaker and The Sanctuary; a special NPC and area specialized for caring for your slimes, particularly with helping your Radiant Slimes shed some of that Prisma energy (while still retaining their lovely radiant colors). This includes special ranch expansions and rooms which you can set to different themes and decorate, along with themed alcoves where your most cherished slime friends can hang out. We’re very excited to see how everyone customizes these!
What is more, these rooms can generate a new currency: Sprinkles! These can be used to unlock expansions in The Sanctuary, new themes, gadgets and decorations.
We know that’s already a lot of amazing stuff, but we didn’t stop there! We’ve also added:
A New Toy, the Resource Detector - it “actually” works as intended; indicating if a crafting resource is nearby. Batteries ARE included!
Gadget Bundles: Amazing deals in the Coo-Coo Corner on loads of decorations.
An Improved Storage Capacity upgrade for Silos; bringing each up to a 200 item limit per slot.
A Growth Amplifier upgrade for your gardens; granting extra growing space to get more of those home grown veggies and fruits your slimes love.
We hope everyone has a blast looking for Radiant Slimes and building out The Sanctuary. Stay wiggly ranchers!
Rare and shimmering versions of slimes that are wondrous on their own and add extra special magic when taken care of in The Sanctuary.

The Sanctuary - a new mystery within the Labyrinth unveils an exciting new ranch expansion with increased customizable themes and rewards; make sure to decorate it and make each room something special!
Includes a “Lost and Found” which will recover any Radiant Slimes lost in their original base form.
Sprinkles are a new currency that can be generated by unleashing your creativity within the rooms of the Sanctuary and is used to unlock more rooms, themes, and more.
Silo: Improved Storage Capacity - This increases the storage capacity of each slot to 200.
Garden: Growth Amplifier - Expands the growing space of each garden plot to increase your crop output.
Resource Detector - This toy is for you! Pick it up to start detecting and track the direction of nearby science resources.

We know how special each ranch and its collection of slimes is to each rancher, and we feel this update is going to help take that personalization to the next level. We can’t wait to see what wonderful habitats you wonderful ranchers make for your slimes, old and new!

A Gordo-sized thank you is in order to the Slime Rancher community for all the love after the game’s full release. Our heartbeets have grown three times bigger! Even after update v1.0.0, the team is back with another update to further refine the world of Slime Rancher 2 with the complete collection of Slime Toys, addition of more gadgets, and in-game tweaks based on player feedback.

notes.title: Toys, Trimmings, and Tune-Ups Features Overview

items.text: A Toy for Every Slime: No slime should have to go without their favorite slime toy! The remedy: a complete collection of toys for every slime. While toys usually decrease their slime’s agitation, some special toys cause curious effects. Decorate slime corrals with the right toy and see for yourself!

Shadow Pots: Players can now find shadow pots throughout the Grey Labyrinth. Break them open to reveal a host of Shadow Slimes inside. Or maybe get creative and take them to a different location to maximize your earnings…

More Gadgets and Variants: Customize the Conservatory and Rainbow Island with an expanded menu of various gadgets and variants to diversify play and decorating styles. Create mechanized chaos or an aesthetic haven for your favorite slimes.
Quality of Life Upgrades: The team has implemented a variety of updates and fixes, ranging from improved and polished lighting to updating crafting UI for a smoother player experience.
Added a skip button to the outro and credits.
Added an orange dot indicator on base gadgets for variants that have been unlocked, but not yet viewed.
The cursor is now hidden on loading screens.
Pressing F1 on an upgrade component prompt from a treasure pod, blueprint, or Ghost Done now takes players to the associated page or upgrade in the Slimepedia.
Improved and polished lighting across all areas and zones in game resulting in smoother lighting transitions between interior and exterior spaces.
Added a photosensitivity warning screen when game loads.
Added new setting toggles for vac shoot, jet pack, and vac suction.
Includes a note warning players that changing settings can create discrepancies within the game tutorials.
Added new audio setting toggles. Players can now choose to mute all audio when the game is paused or when the game is not focused.
Updated the new game screen so that players are directed to the New Game Setting Menu to configure basic graphics settings.
Players can now pin, unpin, and view pinned blueprints and player upgrades from the Fabricator and Slimepedia.
Players can additionally see a crafting blueprint or upgrade and its progress while gathering resources out in the world.
Added Shadow Pots, similar to Gold Pots, to help players struggling to gather Shadow Plorts.
Improved the visual effects of Treasure Pods and their surrounding areas.
Added a new start pointer and tutorial that pops up the first time players interact with the Comm Station.
Beatrix went shopping! Added a shirt bump mesh to the in-game model.
Minor visual and functional slime improvements. See if you can spot the differences.
Minor asset improvements and LOD re-work.
Added feather particles when chickens are eaten. Yum!
Added a new environment interaction with waterfalls. Try shooting something through the cascade.
Players can now run laps around Rainbow Island with less energy drained.
Added Plort Collector upgrades to both the Pond and Incinerator Land Plots.
The Pop! Achievement is now awarded retroactively.
Odd Onions can now be selected as a target for Explorer Drones.
Adjusted Explorer Drones to no longer gather high rates of plorts over a short period of time with max energy and max resources.
Updated “Feral” toggle to “Feral Aggression” in the Settings menu to better reflect the options purpose.
Floating slime statues continue to persist in the world instead of disappearing.
‘Mark All As Seen’ now clears the visual dot indicator for unseen items as intended.

On consoles, FPS does not reach optimized levels next to the swamp Hyper Gordo.
Looking Forward to the New Year

With this update, we say goodbye to 2025 and move on to welcome the new year. Players can expect continued development of Slime Rancher 2, with our next update optimistically on track to release sometime in the spring or summer of 2026. Our beloved community’s support continues to fuel and inspire the team. Thank you, Ranchers, for being a very special part of our wiggly world.
For all things related to Slime Rancher 2 support, please visit the official Slime Rancher 2 Help Center.

Doors and pods in progress that meet the new needed cost will provide their rewards automatically, however UI pop ups may not appear if the player is not close enough when opening

The team is excited to finally share the emotional climax of Beatrix’s adventure and the fate of Rainbow Island. In the v1.0 update, A Hero in Time, players will explore the deepest passages of the Grey Labyrinth to find the source of the power that threatens Rainbow Island, and the whole of the Far, Far Range. Arm yourselves with new gadgets, vac upgrades, and the buzziest Quantum Drones a Rancher could ask for.

notes.title: A Hero in Time Features Overview

items.text: The Grey Labyrinth’s Core: Follow Beatrix to the very heart of the mysterious Grey Labyrinth and discover a brand new zone that leads players to Rainbow Island’s Prismacore. Search every nook and cranny of these puzzling ruins in order to uncover the Labyrinth’s buried secrets. Tread carefully, Ranchers. Danger awaits you, as it does every hero, in Slime Rancher 2’s thrilling finale.

Quantum Drones For Every Rancher: Those beloved, buzzing bees from Slime Rancher have returned, but with a Quantum upgrade! An adorable and expressive helper drone, Quantum Drones now have updated capacities to assist players with ranching at the Conservatory and resource collecting out on the range. Strange though, tech like this shouldn’t be possible. Unless…

An Electrifying New Slime: A speedy and stylish new slime can be found deep in the Grey Labyrinth. These adrenaline junkies can be difficult to corral and will keep even an experienced Rancher on their toes. Keep a close eye on these hyperactive slimes; they love ricocheting off any surface with incredible bursts of energy.

Stacked Rancher Upgrades and Gadgets: In this update, players will find new vacpack and player-specific upgrades to navigate and explore the Grey Labyrinth in its entirety, plus a host of new gadgets and gadget variants to assist players in all their exploration and decorating needs.

Calling All Achievement Hunters: Patient players can now start earning achievements on Steam. Some special achievements will be earned retroactively, while others will require players to unlock that particular action in game a second time. Now, Ranchers, get hunting!
A Story Ends and Secrets Are Revealed

This update takes players into the heart of the Grey Labyrinth – traversing a mysterious terrarium, revealing hidden passages to a sonic secret, and facing a monstrous foe in its final moments. It’s up to you and your new friend Gigi to unveil the secret of the Prismacore and save Rainbow Island. But what of Gigi’s own secrets? Only time will tell…
Quantum Drones: A Bizzy Rancher’s Best Bud

A familiar, albeit upgraded, face returns with Quantum Drones. These cute robo-gadgets assist players in all their ranching and resource collecting needs. Their ability to swap between two different modes, Rancher or Explorer, greatly improves this gadget’s usefulness around Rainbow Island. Just make sure to keep these busy bees fueled up with plorts! With all this free time, Ranchers everywhere can explore without a care in the world.
Rancher Mode, when placed on the Conservatory, allows drones to automate slime care, gardening, and clean up by completing programmed tasks.

Explorer Mode, when placed out in the wilds, tasks drones with harvesting resources across Rainbow Island. Players will have immediate access to these gathered resources via the new Quantum Cloud inventory.

After a hard day’s work, Quantum Drones can get a little sleepy. Utilize Drone Stations to charge their batteries and get a little R&R, as well as program and fuel drones with plenty of plorts. Each crafted station comes with its own paired drone.

Thank you to our incredible community for supporting Slime Rancher 2’s ongoing development and updates. We have some of the most dedicated, creative, and sweetest players on this side of the Far, Far Range. It can’t be overstated how much your support means to the studio, and how your passion for this wiggly world continues to inspire us. So, Ranchers (new and old!), enjoy the full experience of Slime Rancher 2 and take the leap with Bea into a thrilling finale.

This might leave players wondering: is this the end? Far, far from it, friend! The team is already hard at work on our next update. The community should expect to see continued development and refinement of Slime Rancher 2 including a host of balances, fixes, and quality of life features, as well as new gameplay content. As always, keep an eye out for more info across our social media accounts. But for now, happy ranching!

Our Gordo-sized update to Slime Rancher 2 finally hits Rainbow Island! Players will be propelled into the Grey Labyrinth with an arsenal of new gadgets and vac upgrades. Explore the cavernous depths, discover brand new species of slimes, encounter the unnatural phenomena of Prisma Disruptions, and join Beatrix as her story continues to unfold. Prepare yourselves, Ranchers!

Dive Into the Grey Labyrinth: Enter the mysterious Grey Labyrinth and begin to unravel the mysteries of Rainbow Island. Players will need to rely on their wits to travel deeper into this massive new area, with only the most curious players rewarded for their keen eyes and thoughtful exploration. Solve puzzles, discover hidden secrets, and see where Slime Rancher 2’s story takes our leading lady.

Investigate Prisma Disruptions: Explore the Labyrinth’s depths and come face to face with the phenomena called Prisma Disruptions. These enigmatic, rainbow shimmers appear throughout the Labyrinth to varying degrees. It’s said Prisma Disruptions affect not only the environment, but resources as well. Players should exercise the utmost caution when approaching this beautiful, yet chaotic and dangerous, phenomena.

Encounter Strange, New Slimes: Within the Grey Labyrinth are slimes the likes of which have never been seen in all of the Far, Far Range. Be the first to snag these otherworldly (but still wiggly), new friends. But keep in mind that not every slime can be ranched.

Rancher Upgrades and Gadgets: This update introduces 6 key vacpack and player-specific upgrades in order to enter and safely traverse the Grey Labyrinth. A combined catalogue of 18 new gadgets and gadget variants also gives players the tools necessary to improve their ranching flow and exploration, and expands the roster of decorative gadgets for the Conservatory.
Meet Your Mysterious Host: Beatrix will finally meet who summoned her to Rainbow Island and for what purpose…

This update includes a massive, varied, new zone to explore that effectively doubles the size of the map of Slime Rancher 2 so far. This almost alien, unpredictable environment will test even the most experienced Rancher – so make sure to keep your eyes peeled and thoughtfully explore its winding halls and perplexing expanses.

Exploring the Labyrinth will have you journeying through stone paths carved by steady streams of water and molten lava to sprawling towers among the clouds where slimes bask in a soft haze, seemingly engulfed in a never-ending sense of dreaminess. And within its heart someone patiently waits for you…

These kaleidoscopic rainbow energy surges can happen throughout the Grey Labyrinth and warp the environment around them. Some create impossible obstacles, others change the nature of resources they come into contact with. Players should exercise caution when approaching these unstable and mysterious phenomena. One might be able to use the strange gold gates scattered throughout the area. But how?

In order to help players navigate through these new and massive spaces, the Grey Labyrinth comes with its own detailed map. This feature will only be available to players while inside the Labyrinth itself. Full access to the map will require players to activate map nodes throughout the area. So get exploring, Ranchers!
With the help of Disruption Detectors, the Labyrinth Map will also help players track Prisma Disruptions similarly to the weather tracking feature.

As 2024 comes to a close, we want to thank our incredible community for your constant support! Your passion and enthusiasm for the world of Slime Rancher is only mirrored by our own. We hope your exploration of the Grey Labyrinth is filled with surprises and utter delight. Make sure to take in the details our team has so carefully crafted.

Despite how massive this update is, know that this update will only take players through a portion of the Labyrinth and the rest of Rainbow Island’s mystery will be unveiled in our next update. We’ll be sure to share more information on what’s to come next and when in 2025. In the meantime, explore the Grey Labyrinth with Beatrix to its fullest! Happy ranching!

Stay cool and wiggly this summer, Ranchers!

Get in, Rancher. We’re going shopping at ProntoMart! Our second content update of the year slides in right in time for a summer of fun with a slew of new gadgets, gadget variants, and the much-anticipated return of Slime Toys.

notes.title: Add to Cart, ProntoMart Features Overview

items.text: Spend Your Newbucks at ProntoMart: This update introduces a brand new shop system to spend all your hard-earned Newbucks. Head over to ProntoMart to shop for anything from blueprints to toys to cozy decorations. Building off the previous update, ProntoMart will help aid players in their adventuring and ranching journeys. And keep a close eye out for the shop’s purrfect friend.

Go Go Gadget Variants: This update invites players to really make the ranching experience their own, adding your personal aesthetic and play-style with a hefty combination of functional and deco gadgets. Customize your experience on Rainbow Island with a new roster of 51 unique gadgets and 31 gadget variants. The customization possibilities are endless!

Slime Toys Bouncing Back: We all know a well-fed slime is a happy slime. But slimes can also get agitated by the stresses of Rainbow Island. (Have you seen those hungry Tarr?) Soothe them with the return of Slime Toys! Players can buy these special toys through the ProntoMart kiosk. We’ve brought back some old favorites and introduced new ones ready to be loved!

Players can find the ProntoMart kiosk located in the Conservatory. Within the shop, players can access Polestar Provisions and Coo-Coo Corner. Polestar Provisions sells the blueprints needed to craft gadgets. Coo-Coo Corner is a daily deals shop where players can purchase deco and functional gadgets, or toys to entertain slimes. Deals will change every in-game day, so make sure to check the shop frequently!
Remember, it’s possible for players to obtain items before getting a blueprint. Make sure you’re carefully exploring Rainbow Island and checking the Comms Station.

More gadgets means more ways to unleash creative and mechanized chaos upon the wiggly inhabitants of Rainbow Island. Along with a whole catalog of brand new gadgets, this update also introduces gadget variants to the world of Slime Rancher 2.

Gadget variants are existing gadgets with a twist – a color, texture, or design variation of an already existing gadget. This will allow players to get creative and further customize their Conservatory. Keep in mind: not all gadgets have variants and variants can be acquired before the base version of a gadget. Try to collect them all!
Players can toggle through variants when a previously placed gadget is selected. Variants can also be viewed in the Fabricator and Slimepedia.

Slime Toys soothe agitated slimes, so long as they’re within range. They can be purchased through the ProntoMart kiosk through the Coo-Coo Corner. We’ve brought back some Slime Rancher favorites as well as added some brand new Slime Toys to the roster. Remember that while some toys are particular favorites of specific slimes, the platform exclusive Slime Toys are beloved by all.

Players can expand their Conservatory with The Digsite. This expansion adds four new plots for all your ranching and decorating needs, assuming you can tidy up the mess. As it’s a site of archeological curiosity, you’ll also find hidden caches of Deep Brine Nodes and Jellystone that we’re certain you will send to a museum instead of using it all for yourself …right?

We’re nearing the halfway point of this year and bubbling with excitement on what’s still to come!

In case you missed it, Slime Rancher 2 is coming to PlayStation 5 so more people can join in on the wiggly fun. Players who have pre-ordered the game will be able to play on June 7th, while general access opens up on June 11th. (Pre-orders are still open too!) Future content updates leading up to 1.0 are included and will be published in tandem with other platforms. We’ll share a PS5-specific version of the patch notes too.

Our next content update is on track to ship this fall – and the Grey Labyrinth finally opens to the most curious of Ranchers. As always, your support is invaluable to the team and lights a fire in us!

We’re still on track for our Summer 2024 and Fall 2024 updates this year, and we hope to share more details with you soon. In the meantime, keep tinkering away with the new gadgets system. We love to see all the wacky and creative contraptions you come up with!
As always, thank you for your support and keep an eye out for more Slime Rancher 2.

The first content update of the year redefines the gadget system in Slime Rancher 2. Get creative and transform Rainbow Island with a new catalog of stylish, surprising, and silly gadgets. Create an aesthetic oasis for your slimes, overhaul your Ranch from corner to corner, or unleash mechanized chaos on the wiggly inhabitants of Rainbow Island. The world is your playground!

Expanded Interaction with Slimes: The 'Gadgets My Way' update introduces imaginative and lively interactions with slimes. Imagine your slimes lounging on the beach, getting thrilled in homemade pinball machines, or playfully bouncing through fields of colorful pinwheels. This update offers a wide array of thematic settings - from serene to playful - allowing players to create memorable experiences with their slimes on Rainbow Island.

Comprehensive Building System Overhaul: Experience a transformative building system with key features that include a streamlined Gadget mode HUD, offering a more intuitive building experience, and an innovative collection review system integrated into the updated Slimepedia. This update not only enhances the ease of constructing your dream ranch but also enriches the process of discovering and cataloging your unique slime and gadget collections.

More Gadget Content and Exploration: Dive into a world of discovery with 36 new gadgets and treasures waiting in hidden nooks and crannies of Rainbow Island. The update invites players to uncover secret treasure pods, unveiling gadgets that enhance the immersive and interactive nature of the game. Explore new areas, unveil mysteries, and enrich your ranching experience with these exciting additions.
Gadget placement restrictions have been eliminated and gadgets are no longer destroyed upon pickup. Drop gadgets anywhere you like, but make sure there’s enough space for larger gadgets.

You can now peruse through the gadget inventory without having to return to the fabricator. Easily cycle through your most beloved gadgets with the addition of a favorites bar. Gadget categories have also been updated.

You may notice that some of the pre-existing placement hotkey controls are different. After months of rigorous testing, we’ve determined this new system is optimized for long-term, optimal navigation. So please excuse the slight learning curve with this update.
And for all you explorers out there, we’ve dropped several new gadgets in the world for you to discover. Search high and low for these hidden gems, and gather blueprints to craft new gadgets!
Many new gadgets have been added that can interact with slimes, or work with existing gadgets to change the theme of the Conservatory or the world outside.
New resources have been added that can be found during thunderstorms and windstorms. But act fast! These materials only linger for a short while before vanishing.

All zones have had minor expansions added to them, making the world a little larger and more interesting. Perhaps you can find a good use for these spaces with all those new gadgets? We’d love to see it!

We’re constantly amazed by the show of support for Slime Rancher 2 and for our studio. We can’t wait to see all the creative ways you transform your Ranch and Rainbow Island! Thank you for joining us on this journey.
We're bringing players an entirely new gadgets system with our first content update of 2024: Gadgets My Way!
A catalog of 36 new decoration and functional gadgets obliterate placement restrictions! You’ll be able to customize Rainbow Island and play your way. The update drops on February 8th.
We’ll be sharing more details and patch notes on the day of release. See you there, Ranchers!

Get swept up in our newest content update for Slime Rancher 2! All sorts of weather patterns hit Rainbow Island for the very first time. Navigate through heavy rains, thunderstorms, iridescent pollen, and even massive cyclones. As you explore, be on the lookout for some familiar slimes and their favorite snacks!

notes.title: Come Rain or Slime Features Overview

items.text: Dynamic Weather System: Slime Rancher 2 now features a dynamic weather system. Players will experience varying degrees of Rain, Wind, Thunderstorms, Pollen, and more across the world. Brave the elements as more severe weather strikes, or take a load off to enjoy the cozy ambiance of milder weather patterns.
Expanded Original Score: Each severe weather pattern features a beautiful new melody to accompany your treacherous dash home or daring storm chasing adventure.

Dervish and Tangle Slimes Return: Riding in on cyclones during windstorms or popping out of the ground through tangles of creeping vines, Dervish and Tangle Slimes return to join Beatrix’s latest adventure. Carefully track severe weather patterns to wrangle these elusive slimes!

Tasty Snacks: We can’t leave these newly wrangled Tangle and Dervish Slimes hungry! Their favorite foods Prickle Pears, Painted Hens, and Painted Chickadoos also return. Remember: A hungry slime is an unhappy slime, and we don’t want any unhappy slimes…

Slimepedia Makeover: The Slimepedia has undergone an extensive overhaul to make learning about the world of Slime Rancher a much easier experience. Poke around and enjoy the new beautiful interface. Be sure to check the map for the latest weather!

A dynamic weather system has been added that can produce a variety of weather patterns in a zone at varying levels of intensity, even combining with others to create turbulent storms across Rainbow Island. Weather patterns can be tracked via the map.

Please note that dynamic weather only begins after two in-game days have passed and in zones that have already been explored. This means that a fresh save file will potentially see weather on day 3 in a zone already visited once before, and existing saves must have two more in-game days pass after receiving the update before weather patterns will form.
Wind, with varying levels of intensity, culminating in a windstorm that can stir up whirling cyclones, and features a unique musical score.
Rain, with varying levels of intensity, culminating in a rainstorm that can create puddles and waterfalls, and features a unique musical score.

Thunder, with varying levels of intensity, culminating in a thunderstorm that can cause lightning bolts to rain down from above, and features a unique musical score. Thunderstorms often occur during rainstorms, but not exclusively.
Pollen, with varying levels of intensity, culminating in the growth of creeping vines in the area, and features a unique musical score.
Snow, which remains exclusive to Powderfall Bluffs, where the unnaturally cold climate can support it.
And finally, Slimefall. Wait, Slimefall? Oh no…

As always, thank you to our vibrant community for your continued support! We hope you’re enjoying the wintery wonders of Powderfall Bluffs and have kicked up a snowball fight or two. We’re currently tinkering away, but be on the lookout for what’s next in Slime Rancher 2.

The first major content update for Slime Rancher 2 has arrived! Discover Powderfall Bluffs, a mysterious, glacial island off the coast of Ember Valley. As if it were a giant, icy time capsule, you’ll find a thriving community of prehistoric Saber Slimes and Thundercluck chickens within, as well as strange, auroral anomalies, a treasure trove of new resources, and more!

Powderfall Bluffs is a prehistoric frozen island that has mysteriously emerged from the Slime Sea. It’s an icy biome unlike anything ever seen in Slime Rancher, but you’ll need to find it first before enjoying this winter wonderland. Here’s a hint: the entrance to it is located somewhere in Ember Valley…

This snowy sanctuary is home to Saber Slimes—a ferocious blast from the past! And this update also includes a new, RARE slime, but we don’t want to make it overly easy for you to find it so that’s all the info you’re getting from us…
Prehistoric Thundercluck chickens roam among the snowdrifts. They’re scary looking! But they just look like dinner to a Saber Slime.
Powderfall Bluffs offers many new precious resources from its frigid peaks including impossibly Perfect Snowflakes, rare Sun Sap, and adorable Slime Fossils.
Start an icy dust-up anywhere with the Snowball Machine or put other handy gadgets to use like the Hydro Shower, Location Markers, and new Warp Tech.

Craft a giant snowflake just because you can, or a snow globe that plays music to really set the mood, as well as golden slime and chicken statues and earn the admiration (or at least curiosity) of your fellow ranchers.
Phantom-like flora gleam throughout the landscape and nightfall illuminates bridges that allow you to reach new heights along the icy mountains—but act fast before they vanish with the dawn.
Slimes love to play in the snow and won’t hesitate to engage in a snowball fight with you and other slimes!

Song of the Sabers is our first major content update for Slime Rancher 2 and aims to deliver more of what you know and love about Slime Rancher, with a few surprises along the way.

Following this update, Monomi Park will be developing new features that build upon the core activities and game systems of Slime Rancher, allowing you to experience Rainbow Island in new ways. We’re excited about this set of features that we think will wiggle, jiggle, and shake up the Slime Rancher formula.

Further out, Beatrix’s adventure will finally take her into the massive and mysterious Grey Labyrinth that blocks her progress across the furthest reaches of the island. And though its purpose and history remain unknown, it's clear that the key to unlocking the secrets of Rainbow Island lies beyond its walls.
